data.narrative:
Verkor is a Series C climate and energy company that has raised €3B+ to date. The valuation assessment triangulates against a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy) alongside a broader universe of 8 additional climate-tech peers and 1 public comparable.

The peer-median method applies a median valuation of $1.0B derived from the three closest comparables. KoBold Metals trades at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M, establishing a range of $700M to $3.0B within the immediate peer cohort. This method is the primary quantitative anchor given data availability at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $850M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. Key uncertainties include the substantial 4.3x spread within the peer set—reflecting wide dispersion in how the market values early-stage climate technology—and reliance on a single applicable method. Capital deployed ($3B+) and founder team composition are noted but do not independently resolve valuation absent revenue, margin, or asset-backed metrics. Refinement would require progress milestones or comparable transaction data.
